page.description: Promotions on your menu: a banner, a pop-up or a short ad, at the times you choose.
page.emptyDescription: Happy hour, Sunday brunch, a lunch deal: show it on your menu when you choose, with a discount on the dishes you pick if you like.
page.atLimit: A menu holds up to {{limit}} offers. Delete one you no longer use to add another.
page.removeDescription: It leaves your menu at once. Orders already placed with it keep their price.
page.timezone: Times follow your restaurant's time zone, {{timezone}}.
page.offWhilePos: Off while your menu is connected to a POS. Your offers are kept and come back when you disconnect.

banner.name: Banner
banner.hint: A card at the top of your menu, under the cover

popup.name: Pop-up
popup.hint: Opens over the menu when a guest arrives

ad.name: Short ad
ad.hint: Slides in at the bottom; guests can close it after a short countdown

editor.title: Title
editor.photoHint: Optional. It is cut to the shape you pick next, so keep what matters near the middle.
editor.whereHint: A pop-up and a short ad can go together: the short ad then comes after the pop-up is closed.
editor.linkHint: Opens in a new tab. Starts with https://
editor.discountHint: Comes off each dish you tick below, size included. Add-ons stay full price. If two offers cover the same dish, guests get the better price.
editor.dishesHint: Tick the dishes this offer is for.
editor.noDishes: Add dishes to your menu first.
editor.untilHint: Empty: no end. With no time, it runs to the end of that day.
editor.monthDaysHint: The 31st also runs on the last day of shorter months.
editor.allDayDescription: Switch off to show it only at certain times, like a happy hour.
editor.pastMidnight: Ends the next day, after midnight.
editor.activeDescription: Switch off to pause it without losing it.
editor.showText: Write a title and text on it
editor.showTextDescription: Switch off when your picture already says everything: guests then see the picture alone.
editor.photoOnlyHint: Guests see this picture alone and tap it. It is cut to the shape you pick next, so keep your words near the middle.
editor.adShape: Always a wide rectangle, at the bottom of the screen.
editor.leaveDescription: What you changed in this offer will be lost.
editor.adAfterPopup: Short ad shows after the pop-up is closed, in
editor.adStays: Short ad can be closed after
editor.notApplied: does not apply: costs less than the discount
editor.tooSmall: Your picture is small ({{width}} x {{height}} pixels): it may look soft on phones. One at least 1200 pixels across looks sharp.
editor.schedulesOff: Schedules are not on your package: an offer is always on.
editor.discountsOff: Discounts are not on your package: an offer is a promotion only.
editor.gives: What does the offer give guests?
editor.secondHint: Any two dishes ticked below make a pair: the first is full price, the second is free or cheaper, size included. Add-ons stay full price.
editor.showsOutsideHoursDescription: Guests always see the offer, but the deal works only on these days and hours. A tap outside them tells guests when it is available.
editor.builtGroupNote: From Build your own. Priced by what each guest picks, and the discount comes off that too.

summary.noMonthDays: on the days of the month you pick

validation.titleRequired: An offer needs a title in {{language}}.
validation.link: Add a link that starts with https://.
validation.discountValue: Enter how much the discount takes off.
validation.percentMax: A discount can take off at most 90%.
validation.dishes: Choose the dishes this offer is for.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
validation.weekdays: Pick at least one day of the week.
validation.monthDays: Pick at least one day of the month.
validation.sameTime: Ends when it starts. For the whole day, switch on All day.
validation.pastMidnightNotLast: Only the last time of a day can run past midnight.
validation.pictureNeeded: Add a picture, or switch on the title and text.
validation.amountTooBig: {{dish}} costs {{price}}: a discount must take off less than that.
validation.dealName: The deal dish needs a name in {{language}}.
validation.dealCategory: Choose a category for the deal dish.
validation.discountOrDishes: Pick a discount, or let a tap show the dishes.
validation.secondMax: The second one can be at most 100% off, which makes it free.

toast.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.hint: Wide, twice as long as it is tall

square.name: Square
square.hint: As tall as it is wide

tall.name: Tall
tall.hint: Taller than wide, like a phone screen

review.pictureAndText: A picture with a title and text
review.textOnly: A title and text, no picture
review.adAfterPopup: the short ad {{count}} s after the pop-up closes
review.dealTap: A tap opens the deal dish

slots.label: Switched on now
slots.tileFull: All in use: pause or end one first

noRoom.banner: No free banner: pause or end another banner first.
noRoom.popup: No free pop-up: pause or end the other pop-up first.
noRoom.ad: No free short ad: pause or end the other short ad first.

warnings.noDishes: No dishes left on it: choose its dishes again.
warnings.allHidden: All its dishes are hidden from the menu.
warnings.tooBig: Does not apply to {{dishes}}: the discount is not less than the price.
warnings.waits: Not shown for now: guests see one pop-up or short ad per visit, and {{title}} comes first. Drag this card above it to show this one instead.
warnings.schedulesOff: Schedules are not on your package: this offer stays off the menu.
warnings.placesOff: Its places are not on your package: this offer stays off the menu.

placeOff.banner: Banners are not on your package: this offer doesn't show as one.
placeOff.popup: Pop-ups are not on your package: this offer doesn't show as one.
placeOff.ad: Short ads are not on your package: this offer doesn't show as one.

warnings.discountOff: Discounts are not on your package: this offer shows without its discount.

whole.tall: Your picture is much taller than this shape: guests see it whole, on a soft blurred copy of itself at the sides.
whole.wide: Your picture is much wider than this shape: guests see it whole, on a soft blurred copy of itself above and below.

trimmed.tall: Your picture is a little taller than this shape: a strip at its top and bottom is trimmed.
trimmed.wide: Your picture is a little wider than this shape: a strip at its sides is trimmed.

deal.name: Deal name
deal.needsCategory: The deal dish shows on your menu in one of your categories.
deal.useOfferImageDescription: Switch off to keep the photo the dish has, or to give it a new one.
deal.photoHint: Pick a new photo to replace it. To remove the dish's photo, edit the dish on the Dishes page.
deal.onlyWhileLive: This dish shows on your menu only while the offer is running, and guests can order it only then.
deal.dishesFull: Your package's dishes are all used, so a deal dish cannot be added. Delete a dish to make room.
deal.removeDescription: It leaves your menu when you save the offer.
